abstraction_design.rationale: The shared components are designed around the app's real variation (card lists, sections, sortable tables) and stretch well; costs are the duplicated home-card shape and the repeated per-route head/loader boilerplate. Adding /items means copying that small boilerplate plus a builder — acceptable, not exemplary.

findings.issue: buildHomeData hand-builds HomeSpecies duplicating the card fields (id, name, label, sprite) already produced by cardsFromPokemonRefs, so card-level changes (e.g. sprite derivation, sorting, new badge) must be made twice
findings.suggestion: Have buildHomeData reuse a shared card builder (or make HomeSpecies extend CardData and add types/generation), so every card list comes from one code path

findings.issue: Card sprites are synthesized from a URL pattern (id → /media/sprites/pokemon/<id>.png) instead of read from the Pokémon record's sprites.front_default, which the app itself uses for artwork (data.ts:245); a species-vs-variety mismatch (Deoxys) would have no correct source of truth here
findings.suggestion: Resolve sprites from the Pokémon record (the records are cached anyway), or at minimum route every sprite through the existing spriteUrl() seam so a fix touches one function

findings.issue: The /api/v2/ path prefix is hardcoded at ~10 call sites, so changing the API root path is a many-edit change even though the host is centralized in pokeapi.ts:4
findings.suggestion: Add a resource() helper (e.g. resource('move', name)) in pokeapi.ts and route all builders through it

findings.issue: The 404 page sets its document title in a client-side useEffect, so SSR HTML ships the wrong title and the fix lives in a component rather than the framework's head mechanism
findings.suggestion: Use the router's head/notFound integration (e.g. throw notFound() from the root beforeLoad or render meta from the route head fn) so the title is set on the server

findings.issue: API records are typed 'any' throughout the builders, so changing an endpoint's shape produces no compile-time diagnostics
findings.suggestion: Declare minimal interfaces for the handful of API records used (type, move, ability, species) — format.ts already shows the pattern

findings.issue: Module-level promise memoization (speciesMapPromise, versionGroupOrdersPromise) is a second, hidden caching layer that bypasses the pokeapi.ts cache, so a caching-policy change (e.g. TTL) has to touch three places: pokeapi.ts:12, these memos, and route staleTime (routes/index.tsx:22)
findings.suggestion: Move these memoized lookups into pokeapi.ts alongside the existing cache, so all caching policy lives in one module

findings.issue: The view re-derives a typesByName Map from HomeSpecies's raw type-name strings, munging loader data into the shape CardList wants
findings.suggestion: Ship typed type objects ({name,label}) directly in HomeSpecies and delete the view-side map

findings.issue: The head-title pattern (loaderData ? `${title} – Pokédex` : 'Not found – Pokédex') is duplicated in four route files
findings.suggestion: Extract a pageTitle(name) helper (in lib/format.ts) used by all routes

summary: This is a well-seamed TanStack Start app: all fetching sits behind GET server functions, view models are typed interfaces, and every Pokémon-card list flows through one builder and one sprite function, so most fixes land in one place. The main editability costs are the home page's duplicated card assembly, a synthesized sprite URL that ignores the API's own sprite data, a hardcoded /api/v2 prefix scattered across data.ts, and near-total 'any' typing of API records. Adding an Items section means copying small per-route boilerplate rather than reusing a generic abstraction, which is acceptable given how much the pages genuinely differ.
